{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out records where customer_age is -1 (not supplied)
valid_customers = sales_df[sales_df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age of valid customers
mean_age = valid_customers['customer_age'].mean()

# Print the result
mean_age"}
